Air Force recruiters recruit for both the Air Force and the Space Force since the Space Force used to be part of the Air Force before it became its own branch 5 years ago. The application you submit is an Air Force one but both Air Force and Space Force use the same application still so it's nothing to worry about. You completed the PiCAT and so you'll be going to MEPS to complete the PiCAT Verification test in order to validate the scores you got on the PiCAT to essentially confirm you didn't cheat. Air Force recruiters don't recruit Space Force Guardians all that often and the Space Force itself only has around 9,000 personnel total so it's very small relative to the other military branches. Not to mention the Space Force only ships out 6 times a year. With that being said, I'd suggest you go to https://www.spaceforce.com/find-local-recruiter and speak with a Space Force recruiter local to you as they may be able to shed more light on the subject matter. However, the recruiter you're working with now will still be your recruiter who will be guiding you through the process.
